journey.title: Ticking a checkbox inside the preferences dialog keeps it open
journey.goal: Space ticks the checkbox and the dialog stays open

functionalJourney.title: Open and close preferences with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: The dialog opens and the close button dismisses it

guards.title: Done closes the preferences dialog from the keyboard
guards.goal: Activating Done dismisses the dialog and focus returns to the trigger

plan.root_cause: The Space key pressed on a checkbox inside the modal propagates to a listener that closes the modal, causing the modal to lose focus and return focus to the opener button, while the checkbox state does not change.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a Space key handler in the Modal's onKeydown method that stops propagation of the keydown event, preventing unintended modal closure while allowing the default checkbox toggle action to proceed.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Space on a checkbox within the preferences dialog will toggle the checkbox without closing the dialog, keeping focus inside the modal and preserving the dialog's open state.
functional_risks: May interfere with custom Space‑based shortcuts that rely on event propagation within the modal.
If other components depend on Space key bubbling from inner elements, they will no longer receive the event.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Space on the weekly or product offers checkbox toggles the corresponding checkbox and the modal remains open (aria-hidden stays false).
Confirm that pressing Space on the close button (×) or the Done button still closes the modal via their click handlers.
Ensure Escape key continues to close the modal and restore focus to the opener button.
Ensure Tab key trapping still works correctly within the modal (focus loops within modal).

plan.root_cause: The setFocusToFirstNode method contains a variable name typo (nodesWhichAreNotCloseTargets vs nodesWhichAreNotCloseTargets) causing a ReferenceError when the modal opens. This prevents focus from moving to the checkbox, leaving focus on the trigger button. When Space is pressed, the trigger button receives the event and clicks, causing the modal to re-initialize but the focus error persists, and the modal's aria-hidden attribute becomes true (closed). Additionally, the Space key event is not handled in onKeydown, allowing it to propagate and potentially trigger unwanted behavior.
plan.repair_strategy: Fix the variable name typo in setFocusToFirstNode to ensure focus moves to the first non-close-target focusable element (the checkbox). Add a Space key handler in onKeydown that stops propagation to prevent the Space key from bubbling to any ancestor listeners that might close the modal. This ensures that pressing Space on the checkbox toggles it and keeps the modal open.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Space on a checkbox within the preferences dialog will toggle the checkbox without closing the dialog, keeping focus inside the modal and preserving the dialog's open state (aria-hidden remains false).
functional_risks: The fix to setFocusToFirstNode may affect other modals that rely on the previous (buggy) behavior, but the previous behavior was broken.
The Space key stopPropagation may interfere with custom Space-based shortcuts that rely on event propagation within the modal.
If other components depend on Space key bubbling from inner elements, they will no longer receive the event.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Space on the weekly or product offers checkbox toggles the corresponding checkbox and the modal remains open (aria-hidden stays false).
Confirm that pressing Space on the close button (×) or the Done button still closes the modal via their click handlers.
Ensure Escape key continues to close the modal and restore focus to the opener button.
Ensure Tab key trapping still works correctly within the modal (focus loops within modal).

plan.root_cause: The modal fails to open because the initialization function has multiple bugs: generateTriggerMap uses an array instead of an object, init uses undefined variables (triggerAttr, targetModal), and getFocusableNodes passes an array to querySelectorAll causing a TypeError. Additionally, the Space key event propagates and closes the modal when pressing Space on a checkbox.
plan.repair_strategy: Fix generateTriggerMap to return an object, fix init to properly create Modal instances for each modal and register triggers without showing, fix getFocusableNodes to join selectors into a string, fix setFocusToFirstNode to use if-else for clarity, and add a Space key handler in onKeydown to stop propagation.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Enter on the trigger opens the modal, focus moves to the first checkbox, pressing Space toggles the checkbox without closing the modal, and the modal stays open (aria-hidden remains false).
functional_risks: Changes to init may affect multiple modal handling if more modals are added.
The Space key stopPropagation may interfere with custom Space-based shortcuts that rely on event propagation within the modal.
If other components depend on Space key bubbling from inner elements, they will no longer receive the event.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Enter on the trigger opens the modal (aria-hidden becomes false).
Verify that focus moves to the weekly checkbox after opening.
Verify that pressing Space on the weekly checkbox toggles it and the modal stays open.
Verify that pressing Escape closes the modal and restores focus to the trigger.
Verify that Tab key trapping works within the modal.
